observations: 2016 Brassica napus study of BnPME during microspore embryogenesis and comparison with gametophytic development and zygotic embryos.

entities.name: BnPME differentiation correlation
observations: In Brassica napus, BnPME is low during early microspore embryogenesis, totipotency and proliferation, then increases at advanced differentiating stages alongside pectin de-esterification; evidence is correlative, not causal.
